long_biography.plain_text:
John Coustas trained in marine engineering at the National Technical University of Athens, then earned master's and doctoral degrees in computing at Imperial College London. He co-founded Danaos Management Consultants in 1986, applying information systems to ship management before taking responsibility for the family shipping company the following year.

Danaos had been founded by his father Dimitris and operated three multipurpose vessels when Coustas assumed management. He redirected the business toward containership chartering, expanded and modernised the fleet, and took Danaos Corporation public in New York. He remains chairman, president and chief executive, combining majority family control with active corporate leadership. His wider roles have included The Swedish Club, the Union of Greek Shipowners and the DNV Council.
